description.zh:
操作类型： 

- ADD：增加白名单
- DELETE：删除白名单
description.en:
The operation to perform. Valid values:

- ADD: adds users or user groups to the whitelist.

- DELETE: removes users or user groups from the whitelist.

description.zh:
行级权限类型：

- ROW_LEVEL：行级权限，
- COLUMN_LEVEL：列级权限
description.en:
The type of permission. Valid values:

- ROW\_LEVEL: row-level permission

- COLUMN\_LEVEL: column-level permission

description.zh:
授权对象，同时支持多个授权对象，多个对象以英文逗号分隔。取值范围：

- TargetType=1（用户）时，为用户ID。
- TargetType=2（用户组）时，为用户组ID。
description.en:
The IDs of the users or user groups to add to the whitelist.

- If you set TargetType to 1 (user), specify the user IDs.

- When `TargetType=2` (user group), the value is the user group ID.

description.zh:
修改白名单对应的类型：

- 1：用户 
- 2：用户组
description.en:
The type of object to add to the whitelist. Valid values:

- 1: user

- 2: user group

title.zh: 增量修改行列权限白名单

descriptions.zh: >：当前接口仅支持Quick BI新版行列权限模型。若您仍在使用老的行列权限，请先一键迁移至新的行列权限模型后再调用该接口。一键迁移至新的行列权限模型的操作步骤：在组织管理-->安全配置-->行列权限升级新版中，单击**一键升级**，升级至新版行级权限。
descriptions.en: > This API operation supports only the new permission model for row-level and column-level permissions in Quick BI. If you are using the old permission model, you must migrate to the new one before you call this operation. To perform a one-click migration, you can go to Organization Management > Security Configuration > Upgrade to New Row-level and Column-level Permissions and click **One-click Upgrade**.
